title: cyclophorus drakeanus

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as a treatment for wounds and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cyclophorus drakeanus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
